Plot SPUE-vs-model calibration

Source: R/visualize.R
plot_spue_sdm.Rd

Mean modeled value (with ±1 SD) per SPUE bin from compare_spue_sdm().

Usage

plot_spue_sdm(cmp, ylab = "modeled suitability")

Arguments

cmp

output of compare_spue_sdm().

ylab

y-axis label (default "modeled suitability").

Value

ggplot2 plot
